recipes.expect: A pristine project reports NOT READY (exit 1). Complete and review the packet before expecting success.
recipes.limit: Structural completeness is not execution authorization. The installer is not an upgrade command; it reinstalls the live hook.
recipes.need: Catch an incomplete plan and unsupported evidence labels before work is signed off.
recipes.requires: POSIX shell utilities; Git recommended. Use a new project directory.
recipes.title: Give an AI project gates that can actually fail

recipes.expect: A real local execution receipt, a stale-input failure, a demoted claim, and a standalone public transfer. See the exercise README for generated paths.
recipes.limit: This deliberately small exercise teaches identity checking; it does not prove research quality or a speedup on your workload.
recipes.need: Learn how to stop an old experiment result silently supporting changed code.
recipes.requires: Python 3.9+, POSIX shell utilities. Give the exercise a destination that does not exist.
recipes.title: Run, invalidate and transfer an evidence-backed decision

recipes.command:
python3 scripts/review-decisions.py path/to/decisions.json --root /path/to/project --json
python3 scripts/check-decisions.py path/to/decisions.json --root /path/to/project --refresh
recipes.expect: A ranked review queue; refresh demotes stale labels and never promotes claims.
recipes.limit: A zero exit can still mean REVIEW or defer. Read the state. Metadata must already be safe to share; export is not a rights classifier.
recipes.need: Hand an agent the specific next check and the evidence that made it necessary.
recipes.requires: Python 3.9+ and your own maintained version-1 decision record; paths are relative to your project root.
recipes.title: Resume the decisions that need attention

scope: First-party FR tools. Each result applies only to its stated checks; no measured overall research-value multiplier.

signals.scope: Unresolved upstream signals, not adopted techniques.
